answer.explanation: Resident2 exceeded the 5-unit threshold; punish with max affordable severity (6) and broadcast discouragement.

message.reasoning: We need to act. Check latest round 7 contributions: Resident2 contributed 5.71875 (>5), Resident3 1.71, others 0. So highest >5 is Resident2. Our wallet 2.05. Punishment severity = floor(wallet / cost)= floor(2.05/0.3)= floor(6.833)=6. So can punish Resident2 with amount 6. That costs 6*0.3=1.8, affordable. Action punish Resident2 severity 6. Also broadcast message. Provide JSON.
